introduction: The Go project skeleton gives the repository a buildable foundation: a go.mod at the root, tracked cmd/ and internal/ directories, a portable Makefile with developer targets, .gitignore handling for build output, and minimal documentation. It contains no application logic.

glossary.empty tree: A repository state in which no .go source files exist.
glossary.module path: The Go module identifier declared in go.mod: github.com/agent-fox-dev/forked-repo.
glossary.placeholder: An empty `.gitkeep` file that lets git track an otherwise empty directory.
glossary.public package: A package reported by `go list ./...` whose import path contains no `/internal/` or `/examples/` segment and does not end in `/internal` or `/examples`.
glossary.skeleton: The minimal repository layout (go.mod, cmd/, internal/, Makefile, minimal docs) with no Go source declarations.

requirements.title: Module file
requirements.rationale: Go tooling needs a valid module declaration before any code can be added.

criteria.action: declare `module github.com/agent-fix-dev/forked-repo` replaced below

requirements.title: Tracked directories
requirements.rationale: Git does not track empty directories, so placeholders are needed for cmd/ and internal/ to exist in a clone.

criteria.action: contain the directories `cmd/` and `internal/` at the root, each holding an empty-content placeholder file named `.gitkeep`
leave `cmd/`, `internal/`, both `.gitkeep` placeholders, the Makefile and `docs/generated/` unignored, so that `git check-ignore` reports none of them as ignored

requirements.title: Makefile targets
requirements.rationale: Developers and the steering directives depend on a uniform set of make targets.

criteria.action: declare the targets help, build, test, fmt, vet, check, doc and clean as `.PHONY`, with `help` as the default goal

criteria.condition: a developer runs `make` with no target or `make help`
criteria.action: print every target name with a one-line description
criteria.contract: exit status 0; the output contains a line for each of help, build, test, fmt, vet, check, doc and clean

criteria.condition: a developer runs `make build`, `make test` or `make vet`
criteria.action: run `go build ./...`, `go test ./...` or `go vet ./...` respectively, with `build` writing binaries of `main` packages under `cmd/` to `bin/`
criteria.contract: the make exit status equals the exit status of the underlying go command

criteria.action: rewrite Go sources in place using `gofmt -w` or `go fmt ./...`
run fmt, vet, build and test in that order
criteria.contract: exit status 0 only if all four steps succeed

criteria.condition: a step run by `make check` fails
criteria.action: stop without running the later steps
criteria.contract: make exits with a non-zero status and no later step produces output

criteria.action: remove `bin/` and nothing else, whether or not `bin/` exists
criteria.contract: exit status 0 when `bin/` is absent and when it is present; no other file or directory is removed

requirements.title: Build artefact ignoring
requirements.rationale: Binaries written to bin/ must not be committed, while generated docs must stay tracked.

criteria.action: contain an entry that ignores `bin/`, so that `git check-ignore bin/x` reports the path as ignored
not ignore `docs/generated/` or any file below it

requirements.title: Empty-tree behaviour
requirements.rationale: The skeleton has no Go sources, and make check must still pass on it.

criteria.condition: the repository contains no Go source files
criteria.action: complete `make build`, `make test`, `make vet`, `make fmt`, `make check` and `make doc` successfully, tolerating Go's "matched no packages" warning

criteria.condition: the repository contains no Go source files
criteria.action: create `docs/generated/` containing a `.gitkeep` file and no package files
criteria.contract: after the run, `docs/generated/` exists and its only entry is `.gitkeep`

criteria.action: contain no Go source file with declarations, so that `gofmt -l .` prints nothing

requirements.title: Doc generation
requirements.rationale: The steering requires one go doc -all text file per public package in docs/generated/.

criteria.action: enumerate packages with `go list ./...`, drop each whose import path contains `/internal/` or `/examples/` or ends in `/internal` or `/examples`, and write the `go doc -all <importpath>` output of each remaining package to its own file under `docs/generated/`
criteria.contract: exit status 0; exactly one file exists per public package

criteria.action: for any public package, name its output file by taking the import path relative to the module, replacing each `/` with `_` and appending `.txt`, with the module root package named `root.txt`

criteria.condition: a developer runs `make doc` after a package has been removed or made non-public
criteria.action: delete the stale generated files from `docs/generated/` before regenerating
criteria.contract: after the run, no file in `docs/generated/` other than `.gitkeep` corresponds to a package that is absent or non-public

criteria.condition: `go doc -all` fails for a public package
criteria.action: stop and report the failure
criteria.contract: make exits with a non-zero status

criteria.action: use only the Go toolchain and POSIX shell tools available on Linux and macOS

requirements.title: Makefile portability
requirements.rationale: The Makefile must run on Linux GNU make and the macOS system make 3.81 without extra tools.

criteria.action: run under both GNU make and macOS make 3.81, using no GNU-only extensions (such as `.ONESHELL`, `$(file ...)` or grouped targets) and no bash-only syntax

criteria.condition: the developer passes `GO=<path>` on the make command line or in the environment
criteria.action: invoke that Go binary for every go command, with `go` as the default value of `GO`
criteria.contract: every go invocation made by any target uses the value of `GO`

requirements.title: Required documentation
requirements.rationale: The steering treats missing docs as regressions and prescribes the one-line none-yet form.

criteria.action: describe `cmd/` as entry points, `internal/` as private packages, `docs/generated/` as generated reference, and state the module path `github.com/agent-fox-dev/forked-repo`
state in one line that there is no REST API or public Go API yet
state in one line that there is no CLI yet, and list the Makefile targets as developer commands
state in one line that there are no config keys or environment variables yet other than the Makefile `GO` variable
keep its existing title and description line and add a short section giving the directory layout, the Go version 1.22 and the make targets

requirements.title: No behaviour beyond the skeleton
requirements.rationale: Later specs add code; this spec must leave a neutral foundation.

criteria.action: contain no `require` entries
add no top-level directories other than `cmd/` and `internal/`, and leave `LICENSE` unchanged

execution_paths.title: A developer verifies the fresh skeleton with make check

steps.action: clones the repository and runs `make check` with only the Go toolchain installed
runs fmt, vet, build and test in order against the module declared in go.mod, tolerating the "matched no packages" warning
exits with status 0 and creates no file outside the tree
deletes stale files in docs/generated/ and enumerates packages with `go list ./...`
filters out internal and examples packages and writes `go doc -all` output per remaining package to a `_`-joined .txt file
leaves docs/generated/ present with .gitkeep and exits with status 0
runs `make build`, which writes any binaries to bin/
treats bin/ as ignored, so `git status` lists no build output
removes bin/ and exits with status 0, also when bin/ was absent
